preconditions.description: Number of testcases is between 1 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): 1 <= n[i] <= 5*10**4 and 1 <= m[i] <= 10
preconditions.description: For each testcase, the number of permutations n and the length of each permutation m satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): for j in range(n[i]): len(a[i][j]) == m[i] and set(a[i][j]) == set(range(1, m[i]+1))
preconditions.description: Each permutation a[i][j] is a sequence of m distinct integers from 1 to m.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(t): len(output[i]) == n[i]
postconditions.description: The output for each testcase contains n integers.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(t): for j in range(n[i]): output[i][j] == max(beauty(a[i][j] * a[i][k]) for k in range(n[i]))
postconditions.description: The i-th value in the output is the largest beauty of a permutation a[i][j] * a[i][k] over all k.
